edits.why: The agent's commands already run in the OS sandbox, which cannot open another inside it; verify runs outside it, where this test still runs.
#80 on this older tree: under the macOS sandbox a stat of ~/.ssh gives EPERM, so the base's own policy tests failed before the agent changed anything, and agents 'fixed' real() unasked.

prompt:
Implement this change in cedia, the repository you are in (a coding harness in TypeScript on Bun; AGENTS.md and SPEC.md describe it).

<change>
Threads: auto handoff, recall, and threads that message each other

Every headless run is a thread of its project (~/.cedia/projects/<slug>/threads/<id>.jsonl, append-only). When a writer session's context passes --handoff-at (default half the window, at most 150k, below any long-context price) and has doubled since its first reply, it writes a handoff note while its prefix is still cached, and a new session of the thread starts from the task and the note. Nothing is edited, the old log stays searchable with the recall tool, and the done gate still wants a check after inherited writes.

--thread <id> goes on with a thread: in its last session when the model matches, otherwise in a new session that starts from the latest note or result. The threads, read_thread and message_thread tools let a session see and message the project's other threads; messages arrive as a logged reminder at the next turn boundary. cedia threads lists, shows and sends.
</change>

The tests in `test/threads.test.ts` were written for this change and say what it must do. Make them pass without changing them, and keep the whole `bun test` suite passing.
